cumulative.caveats: Exact-binomial PoC on a 12k-pool subsample, unthresholded 16x16 coarse seed, per-depth EM tau (floor 0.005), production gate config: Lindsey lfdr family decision (sigma0 [0.3,6], pi0>=0.05, BH fallback), 80 rounds, GEV=0.35 + 0.25x parent posterior variance in the null, keff>=0.5, >=10 fit points, IRLS step cap 4, locally balanced holdout; no pool effects in the fit, no law machinery.
